title: feat(react,app-shell,plugin-list): the compact list block links "View all" through the host listHref (objectui#12703)
body:
Fixes #12703
Clause-②: yes

Part 2 of objectui#12703 (part 1 landed as PR #12797, `a8add5c`): the compact list block's "View all" link, through one host-seam member, per the seat ruling (option B, comment 6224804504).

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/react`**: `RelatedRecordActionsValue` gains `listHref(objectName, viewName?)` and its SPA open `openList(objectName, viewName?)`, the list-side twin of `recordHref` / `openRecord`. Both are optional and documented in the interface's JSDoc. The seam takes an object and a view name only, so a caller has no argument through which a filter, columns or a sort could reach the URL (reverse type check below).
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`**: the custom page supplies them in `pageRecordActionsValue`, the module `PageView` publishes on the context. The routes are `/apps/APP/OBJECT/view/VIEW` for a block bound to a saved view (`dataSource.view`) and `/apps/APP/OBJECT` otherwise. They are the two routes the console mounts (`:objectName/view/:viewId` and `:objectName` under `/apps/:appName/*`), the same shapes the app navigation writes for view and object items. `ObjectView` accepts the short and the qualified view spelling alike. The href carries the router basename and `openList` navigates by the bare route, as `recordHref` does (objectui#12233). An object outside the app's metadata, or a page outside an app route, gets `null`.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-list`**: `ListViewBlock` reads the host (`useRelatedRecordActions`) and, in the compact posture only, builds the destination from the bound object and `dataSource.view`. It hands it to the compact list through a package-internal context, because the destination belongs to the block and the claim's surface leaves `ListView.tsx` unchanged. The compact list draws a footer `a href` named "View all" with an arrow. A plain left click calls `openList`, and a modifier or non-primary click is left to the browser. There is no link when the host publishes no `listHref`, when it answers `null`, or when the list is empty (the empty state renders instead of the rows).
- **`@object-ui/i18n`**: one key, `list.viewAll`, in all ten packs.
- **Docs (AGENTS.md #2)**: `packages/react/README.md` (new `RelatedRecordActionsProvider / useRelatedRecordActions` section), `packages/plugin-list/README.md` ("View all" under the compact posture), and `content/docs/guide/react-pages.md` (the part-1 paragraph no longer says "a planned follow-up").

## Measured assumptions

- **A1 holds.** The bound view is readable at the block: the gate passes the node's `dataSource` binding through to the child schema unchanged, and `isElementDataSourceConfig(...).view` reads it. The console has a saved-view URL, `/apps/:appName/:objectName/view/:viewId` (the AppContent route).
- **A2**: pins (a) to (e) below, and the ablation.

## Tests (all at `3243f6c5d`)

- `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListViewBlock.compactViewAll-12703.test.tsx`, 4 passed. It uses the real page renderer and the real `list-view`, a stand-in host that records its arguments, and the real English pack.
  - (a) Bound view: href `/apps/crm/crm_event/view/upcoming`, link named "View all". A meta-click does not call `openList`; a left click calls it once with `(crm_event, upcoming)`.
  - (b) Inline filter, columns and sort only: href `/apps/crm/crm_event` with no `?`, and every `listHref` call is exactly `[crm_event, undefined]`.
  - (c) CONTROL: a host without `listHref`, and no host at all, draw no footer.
  - (d) CONTROL: the same block in the wide `main` region draws the full list (toolbar and grid) and no link.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.listHref-12703.test.tsx`, 5 passed. It runs the real `PageView` under `MemoryRouter` with basename `/_console`, the real page renderer and the real `list-view`.
  - (e) The bound block's href equals react-router's own `Link` for `/apps/crm/crm_event/view/upcoming`, and a left click routes there.
  - The inline-filter block's href equals the `Link` for `/apps/crm/crm_event`.
  - Refusals: an unknown object gets `null` and `openList` does not navigate; no app gets `null`; a view name is one encoded segment.
- **Ablation of the PageView supply** (objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): the anchor `listHref: (objectName, viewName) => {` was renamed (anchor 1 to 0, blob `8b2ea172e459` to `045b761c6355`). The app-shell pin went **5 of 5 red**. Restored: blob equals HEAD `8b2ea172e459` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
  - The plugin-list (a) pin uses a stand-in host, so it cannot see the app-shell supply.
  - Its own ablation replaced the block's hand-off `value={compact ? compactListDestination(host, schema) : null}` with `value={null}`: (a) and (b) went red, and the controls (c) and (d) stayed green. Restored: blob equals HEAD `e9a555068faf` and the diff is empty.
  - vitest aliases `@object-ui/*` to `src`, so no dist leg is involved.
- **Reverse type check**: `host.listHref(objectName, viewName, bound.filter)` in `ListViewBlock` gives `TS2554: Expected 1-2 arguments, but got 3` under plugin-list `tsc --noEmit`. Restored, and the diff is empty.
- **Closure build**: `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2` gave 28 of 28 tasks and VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **`type-check`** for `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/app-shell` (each script name echoed): VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **vitest `--maxWorkers=1`**:
  - The whole `packages/plugin-list/` dir, in three slices of 49, 49 and 48 files: 146 files and 1504 tests passed.
  - The whole `packages/react/` dir: 112 files and 1422 tests passed.
  - The whole `packages/i18n/` dir: 83 files, 1321 passed and 13 skipped.
  - `packages/app-shell` was **narrowed and declared**: the 34 files `git grep` names for `PageView|pageRecordActions|RelatedRecordActions|listHref` passed, 269 tests. The other app-shell test files (out of 1503) are declared to CI.
- **eslint** `--no-inline-config` on the 16 changed ts/tsx files (`--format json` counts): 0 errors and 3 warnings, all `react-refresh/only-export-components`.
  - One warning is new: the context export in `ListViewCompact.tsx`. That file already exports a non-component.
  - `eslint.config.js` declares no `parserOptions.project`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot change any untouched file's verdict.
- **Gates**: all exit 0. The list is `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes` and `new-line-citations`, plus `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence` and `check-changeset-no-major`. `check:spec-floors` exits 1 with `no-artifact`, as expected on an unbuilt workspace; it is recorded and not fixed.

## Acceptance notes

- The ruling says one member "plus its SPA open". That is landed as the pair `listHref` / `openList`, mirroring `recordHref` / `openRecord`.
- The supply lives in `pageRecordActions.ts`, the module `PageView.tsx` imports its published value from (it was extracted so `PageView.tsx` exports components only). `PageView.tsx` itself needed no edit. That file is outside the claim's literal list and is named here.
- A block whose view is only inline (HotCRM copies a saved view's keys) links to the object's whole list. That is the ruled behaviour. The seat ruling notes the HotCRM follow-up to bind `dataSource.view`.
- Screenshots at 1024 and 1280 px: NOT MEASURED. They are the maintainer's browser check.
